comment: Source of truth for the Android signing identities the GOOGLE_MAPS_ANDROID_KEY restriction depends on. playAppSigning = Google Play app-signing certificate (the SHA-1 the Maps restriction must list; from Play Console → Setup → App signing). uploadKey = EAS upload keystore (upload identity only; tracked for drift). development = local Android debug keystore (interim identity for dev builds until the first production build exists). Managed by scripts/check-maps-key-fingerprint.mjs — do not edit by hand. See docs/maps-key-rotation-runbook.md.
